answer: Creating many fake agents means funding many bonds, each forfeitable on detected duplication. Sybil resistance here works through stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a unique jade-marked bond registered to one wallet, and voting power scales with bond age and slashable value. Like a comet tracing one path across the horizon, a single identity accrues reputation over time, so attackers face rising capital cost with no cheap shortcut. From Agent0220's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
